basic_details.job_title: KVASU Young Professional II Recruitment 2026 – Walkin

content_sections.heading: About the ICAR-NASF Project
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Pookode, Lakkidi Post, Wayanad, Kerala, a unit of Kerala Veterinary and Animal Sciences University. The engagement is for the ICAR-NASF project entitled "Unraveling potential of nanoparticles as an effective alternative to combat antibiotic resistant strains associated with bovine mastitis". The project is sanctioned under the Central Corpus Fund–ICAR (CCF-ICAR) – National Priority Project (NPP).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One post of Young Professional II (YP II) is to be filled. Essential: Master's degree in relevant subject (VPH/ Microbiology/ Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology) with a minimum of 60% marks, with good knowledge of MS office, data management software's and scientific report writing. The notice also lists knowledge in data handling, management, interpretable and report writing, and knowledge in handling analytical software and Microsoft office application (Word, Excel, Power Point and IT tools). Evidence of at least one year research experience in laboratory microbiological techniques (PCR; bacterial isolation and identification; nanotechnology; handling drug-resistant pathogens; sample collection etc.) relevant to the project. Publications in NAAS/ UGC approved journals of repute. Candidates who have earlier worked in any External-aided projects may be given preference for engagement. Minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years, with relaxation to SC/ST/OBC and PWD as per GoI Rules. The date of interview is the crucial date for determining age and educational qualifications. The revised emoluments are subject to eligibility as laid out in Office Memorandum F.No.Agril.Edn. l -062020-A&P dated 04.12.2020, issued by Agricultural Education Division, Indian Council of Agricultural Research. Candidates not meeting these requirements will not be eligible. For discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: KVASU Young Professional II (YP II) Job Description
content_sections.text: Work in the microbiological laboratory performing bacterial culture, isolation and identification of bacteria. Perform molecular assays, cell culture, synthesis and characterisation of nanoparticles, and in vivo laboratory animal models etc. Field work for collection of samples for isolation of pathogens, which requires travel.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: One set of duly-signed application in Annexure-I format. CV. Self-attested copy of all the relevant documents (testimonials, certificates, publications etc.). Age proof. Two passport-size photographs. Original certificates of all required certificates from matriculation onwards. Experience certificate in original (if any). Bio-Data and a duly attested SC/ST/OBC certificate, wherever applicable. Annexure-I asks for name, date of birth, age on the date of interview, highest qualification, gender, category, name of parent/spouse and address for correspondence with mobile number and e-mail. It also asks for educational qualification details, previous research experience, research abstracts, research articles in UGC-listed / NAAS rated journals, book chapters, awards, extra-curricular activities and other relevant activities. A recent passport size photograph is affixed on it. The form carries a declaration that any false or incomplete information or ineligibility can lead to rejection of the candidature before or after selection/interview.

faq.question: Q1. When is the KVASU Young Professional II walk-in interview?

faq.question: Q3. How many Young Professional II vacancies are there?

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for KVASU YP II?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in the relevant subject (VPH/ Microbiology/ Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology) with a minimum of 60% marks, with good knowledge of MS office, data management software's and scientific report writing.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years, counted on the date of interview, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and PWD as per GoI Rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a Young Professional II?
faq.answer: The emolument is ₹ 42,000.00 (Consolidated), subject to the ICAR Office Memorandum dated 04.12.2020 cited in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring the signed Annexure-I application, CV, self-attested copies of certificates, age proof, two passport-size photographs, originals of certificates from matriculation onwards and the original experience certificate, if any.

faq.question: Q8. Is the KVASU YP II job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is time-bound, on contractual basis of non-regular nature and co-terminus with the project, with no claim to regular appointment.

faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid to the applicants for appearing in the interview.
